item.title: Correction · Mission Bay South Block 18C (UCSF Child Development Center): Block 18C: a childcare…
item.description: Block 18C: a childcare center is listed at 727 Nelson Rising Lane and registered with the city (registration date 2024-01-01), but no source says a building stands there or when it opened. A separate 2026 registration for 'Ucsf Shuttles' at the same address is described as a registration only. Source: Bright Horizons center page (brighthorizons.com); DataSF Registered Business Locations (data.sf.gov/resource/g8m3-pdis.json, certificates 0941054 and 1106713); UCSF CAC presentation 2025-06-12.

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay South Block 18C (UCSF Child Development Center): Block 18C is now named…
item.description: Block 18C is now named 'Mission Bay South Block 18C (UCSF Child Development Center)'. Its identification as the UCSF at Mission Bay Child Development Center, run by Bright Horizons at 727 Nelson Rising Lane, had rested on an on-the-ground observation; it is now sourced. Bright Horizons' own page and the City's business registrations place the centre at that address, the City's address point for 727 Nelson Rising Lane falls inside this shape (about 2.7 m from its edge; the nearest other mapped block is about 20 m away), and UCSF's June 2025 presentation gives the block's near-term use as a childcare center. The address point marks the street frontage, not the building, and the address also carries another business registration, so it is not exclusive to this building. No source gives an opening date. Shape, status and use are unchanged; the old page address now redirects to the new one. Source: Bright Horizons, UCSF at Mission Bay Child Development Center (https://www.brighthorizons.com/daycare-centers/ca/san-francisco/727-nelson-rising-lane-94143); DataSF Registered Business Locations, ttxid 1367181-07-241 (https://data.sfgov.org/resource/g8m3-pdis.json?ttxid=1367181-07-241); DataSF Addresses, address ID 743045 (https://data.sfgov.org/resource/3mea-di5p.json?eas_address_id=743045); UCSF Mission Bay Development Overview, Mission Bay CAC presentation, 2025-06-12 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/2025-06/Item%202%20-%20UCSF%20Mission%20Bay%20Development%20Overview.pdf).

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay South Block 18C (UCSF Child Development Center): Block 18C's notes named a…
item.description: Block 18C's notes named a UCSF childcare centre at 727 Nelson Rising Lane with no citation. The Bright Horizons page for 'UCSF at Mission Bay Child Development Center' at that address is now cited (it gives no opening year), and the notes record that UCSF's June 2025 deck lists 18C as an undeveloped parcel with childcare as its near-term use. Whether this map shape is that centre, and so whether its status of 'existing' is right, remains an open question; it was not changed. Source: Bright Horizons, UCSF at Mission Bay Child Development Center (https://www.brighthorizons.com/daycare-centers/ca/san-francisco/727-nelson-rising-lane-94143); UCSF Mission Bay Development Overview, Mission Bay CAC, 2025-06-12 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/2025-06/Item%202%20-%20UCSF%20Mission%20Bay%20Development%20Overview.pdf).
